summary: Bug hunt found two small bugs and fixed one, plus one backlog idea: the video page now says a due slot is due, and the last Overview stat card no longer sits alone on phones.
why: Both were visible in tonight's phone screenshots; each fix has a smoke test that fails without it. All checks pass (45 smoke tests).

findings.title: Video page said '34m ago' for a slot that is due now
findings.detail: The Queue page said 'Uploading now' for the same video. Fixed.

findings.title: Overview Backlog card counts long videos as Shorts
findings.detail: Shows about 4 days where the Queue page says about 3. The line names a guarded schedule setting, so the dashboard agent can't change it; left in the backlog for the auditor or the owner.

changes.title: Video page: 'Due now' for a due slot
changes.detail: Uses the posting plan's own due state, like the Queue page. Also cleaned an unused lint directive.

changes.title: Overview: last stat card spans the row on phones
changes.detail: No more half-empty row under the five stat cards.
